# Test 12: Multi-level sealed hierarchy inside a record
# Shape -> Circle | Polygon, Polygon -> Square | Triangle.
# Box wraps a Shape. Three record patterns cover all leaf types.
# Expected: exhaustive

TYPES
sealed Shape Circle Polygon
record Circle double:radius parent:Shape
sealed Polygon Square Triangle
record Square double:side parent:Polygon
final Triangle parent:Polygon
record Box Shape:content

SWITCHES
switch s1 Box
record Box(type:Circle)
record Box(type:Square)
record Box(type:Triangle)
end
